description: This PHP class file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) named AccessFlowStateMachineDao responsible for managing workflow state machine records. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, updating, and deleting workflow transition data related to user roles and actions within an organization's HR management system.

classes.name: AccessFlowStateMachineDao
classes.description: DAO class handling database operations for workflow state machine entities, including retrieval of allowed actions, workflow items, next states, and management of workflow records.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of WorkflowStateMachine objects permitted for a specific workflow, role, and optionally a state.

methods.name: getAllowedWorkflowItems
methods.description: Returns workflow state machine entries matching specified workflow, role, and optional state.

methods.name: getNextState
methods.description: Fetches the subsequent WorkflowStateMachine based on current state, role, and action.

methods.name: getActionableStates
methods.description: Retrieves workflow states where specific actions are permissible for a given role and workflow.

methods.name: saveWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Persists a single WorkflowStateMachine entity to the database.

methods.name: saveWorkflowStateMachineRecordAsArray
methods.description: Persists an array of WorkflowStateMachine entities in batch.

methods.name: deleteWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Deletes a specific workflow transition record based on provided criteria.

methods.name: deleteWorkflowRecordsForUserRole
methods.description: Deletes all workflow records associated with a specific role, and optionally a workflow.

methods.name: handleUserRoleRename
methods.description: Updates all WorkflowStateMachine records to replace an old role name with a new role name.

methods.name: getAllAlowedRecruitmentApplicationStates
methods.description: Retrieves all allowed recruitment application states for a specific workflow and role.

methods.name: getWorkFlowStateMachineRecords
methods.description: Retrieves all workflow state machine records associated with a given workflow and optionally filtered by role.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a specific action is allowed in a given workflow, state, and role.

methods.name: getWorkflowItem
methods.description: Fetches a WorkflowStateMachine entity by its primary key ID.

methods.name: getWorkflowItemByStateActionAndRole
methods.description: Retrieves a WorkflowStateMachine record matching specified workflow, state, role, and action.
